reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight is that reality is structured hierarchically through sensory experience, where 'things of sense' form the absolute nucleus. This implies that any formal model of cognition must prioritize perceptual priors. The duality of dream and waking states reveals that reality is not fixed but context-dependent on attention. This leads to a dual-layered structure: one grounded in sensory input and another in abstract belief systems. The failure mode occurs when attention shifts without proper integration, causing reality fragmentation. The epistemological stance assumes that while abstract entities may be real, their reality is subordinate to sensory experience. Thus, GSI models must encode belief strength relative to sensory grounding, and GSE must simulate attention-driven reality transitions.
